title: Cancer, you still have the napkin
caption: for the cancer who still has the napkin. what's in your shoebox?

beats.text: the cancer next door kept the napkin
first date, 2021. his number's on it
you know birthdays of people who forgot yours
ruled by the moon, so you feel it in phases
you walk sideways toward what you want
a hard shell, and a kitchen full of guests
you're not too much. you're a whole house
it has to be mutual. let someone keep you
